x-fal-metadata.about:
Gemini 3 Pro Image is a text-to-image model that generates images from text descriptions.

Decompression-bomb inputs to ``image_urls`` are rejected upstream by
``validate_image_async`` (called from ``GoogleAIClient._format_image``):
the validator now enforces a header-only ``max_image_pixels`` cap
(default 89,478,485 ≈ PIL's ``MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS``) *before* any pixel
decode, so oversized inputs raise a deterministic 422
``image_too_large`` instead of OOM-killing the runner and taking out
every multiplexed request on it (``max_multiplexing=20``).
